title: The Gutenberg Webster's Unabridged Dictionary
summary: "The Gutenberg Webster's Unabridged Dictionary" by Project Gutenberg is an xml file representing Webster's dictionary. The file is no longer maintained as a book. Web versions of this can be viewed at books #660 (A and B), #661 (C), #662 (D and E), #663 (F, G, and H), #664 (I, J, K, and L), #665 (M, N, and O), #666 (P and Q), #667 (R), #668 (S), #669 (T, U, V, and W), #670 (X, Y, and Z).
